definitions.explanation: A device for taking photographs. An older or more formal word for camera, now largely replaced by カメラ in everyday speech.

notes:
An older, more formal Japanese word for camera. While ⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧ is the standard word in modern Japanese, {写真機|しゃしんき} still appears in historical, technical, or literary contexts.

USAGE:
Today {写真機|しゃしんき} is used mainly when:
- Referring to vintage or antique cameras
- Writing in a deliberately formal or historical style
- Discussing the history of photography in Japan

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写真機|しゃしんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧: to hold up a camera
- {写真機|しゃしんき}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: camera shop (dated)
- ⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧{写真機|しゃしんき}: compact camera

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧: camera — the standard modern word used in everyday speech
- ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦{機材|きざい}→機材：13187_kizai⟧: photography equipment — broader term including lenses, tripods, etc.

FORMS:
⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ (photograph) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine, device)
